project_type: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) + Compose Multiplatform — android/iosArm64/iosSimulatorArm64/jvm targets
build_system: Gradle 9.5.1 with version catalog (gradle/libs.versions.toml). Multi-module: core/{common,designsystem,network,navigation,di,datastore,database}, feature/{auth,home,splash}, shared, shared-models. The home feature is feature:home.
test_framework: kotlin.test + kotlinx-coroutines-test, run in jvmTest source set. Test class pattern: StandardTestDispatcher + setMain/resetMain in @BeforeTest/@AfterTest.
verification_instructions: 1) Run .\gradlew :core:designsystem:compileCommonMainKotlinMetadata after FEAT-001 changes. 2) Run .\gradlew :feature:home:jvmTest after FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 to confirm all ViewModel tests pass. 3) Run .\gradlew :feature:home:compileCommonMainKotlinMetadata for a full compile check.
snapshot_or_generated_files: compose.resources generates resource accessors. The designsystem module uses packageOfResClass='com.hussein.jana.core.designsystem' with publicResClass=true. String resource keys become top-level properties (e.g. Res.string.live_lessons_title) auto-generated under the build directory — do not create these manually. Existing imports in ScheduleTabScreen.kt show the pattern: import com.hussein.jana.core.designsystem.Res; import com.hussein.jana.core.designsystem.schedule_sync
environment_constraints: Windows workspace. All worktree paths start with d:\AndroidApps\JANA\JANA. iOS cinterop for EventKit is NOT available — PlatformActions.ios.kt for syncCalendar must call openUrl('calshow://') instead.
contribution_requirements: No explicit AGENTS.md found. Follow patterns in existing code. All string references use the designsystem Res class (not feature-local resources). No hardcoded colors — use MaterialTheme.colorScheme or named tokens from Color.kt. RTL-aware layout using Start/End semantics.
key_patterns: MVI: BaseMviViewModel<S,I,E>(initialState). State in Contract file as data class : MviState. Intent as sealed interface : MviIntent. Effect as sealed interface : MviEffect. ViewModel receives string updates via updateStrings(). Effects collected in stateful screen via LaunchedEffect(viewModel). Koin: koinViewModel() for ViewModels, koinInject() for singletons. All modules registered in core/di/CoreModule.kt (coreModule) or feature-level module (homeModule) in feature/home/.../di/HomeModule.kt. Navigation3: NavKey routes in core/navigation/Routes.kt (sealed interfaces + @Serializable data objects/classes). HomeEntryProvider in feature/home handles HomeRoute entries. AppNavigator singleton in coreModule. DesignSystem: strings in core/designsystem/src/commonMain/composeResources/values/strings.xml (EN) and values-ar/strings.xml (AR). Platform expect/actual in core/designsystem with androidMain/iosMain/jvmMain implementations.
directory_structure: d:/AndroidApps/JANA/JANA/ — workspace root. core/designsystem — shared UI tokens, components, platform actions, all compose resources (strings). core/common — MVI base classes (BaseMviViewModel, MviState/Intent/Effect). core/navigation — Routes, AppNavigator, AppNavHost, FeatureEntryProvider. core/di — CoreModule (registers AppNavigator, HttpClient, etc). core/network — Ktor HTTP client + ApiConfig. feature/home — the only relevant feature module; source set: commonMain only (no androidMain/iosMain/jvmMain for kotlin). Tabs under feature/home/.../tabs/{live,schedule,teachers,janaai,home,chat,courses,profile}. All strings go in core/designsystem composeResources. All platform expect/actual go in core/designsystem source sets.
